intent: Change the effective-fee computation so the effective fee is the base fee PLUS the total of all add-on monthly fees (instead of just the base fee).
notes: MODIFY-COMPUTATION over the CLI (the F8 modify-by-re-express loop via `modify --dry-run`, built 2026-06-08). The `subscription-computed` fixture already carries the computation EffectiveFeeComp = `[BaseFee]` (generated via the real `cli add` write path); the agent must (1) discover the existing computation (`explain --computation` / `read --all`), (2) KEEP the same computed field /Subscription/Billing/EffectiveFee, and (3) re-express it to add the add-on total. The runner's recheck runs `cli modify --computation /Subscription/Billing/EffectiveFeeComp --spec <file> --dry-run` (read-only) — the kernel-authoritative gate that replaces-then-binds (rejecting an invalid re-expression) and reports `changed`; a modify passes only when ACCEPTED and an actual CHANGE (changed:true), then the judge scores equivalence to the gold. Gold verified via `cli modify --dry-run`: the re-expression is accepted (changed:true; before `always => [BaseFee]`, after `always => [BaseFee] + Sum(/Subscription/Addons*/MonthlyFee)`). The Sum reaches the Addons repetition list by ABSOLUTE path (`/Subscription/Addons*/MonthlyFee`) because Addons is a sibling group of Billing, not reachable by a bare name from the Billing context.
